import sys,json,csv,io,base64
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from campaign import audit
from common import parse_json
HDR=('type','id','revision','published','op','lease','event','probe','target','responder','result','service','attempt','payload')
def cap(rows):
 s=io.StringIO(newline='');w=csv.writer(s,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(HDR)
 for r in rows:w.writerow(r)
 return {'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(s.getvalue().encode()).decode()]}
def icmp(rid,rev,pub,event,probe,target,resp,result):
 return ['icmp',rid,str(rev),str(pub),'put','h',str(event),probe,target,resp,result,'','','']
def dele(rid,rev,pub): return ['icmp',rid,str(rev),str(pub),'delete','','','','','','','','','']
def app(rid,event,target,service='t',attempt=0):
 return ['app',rid,'0','10','put','h',str(event),'','2001:db8:1:1200::'+target,'','closed',service,str(attempt),'']
rows=[icmp('w1',0,1,5,'0/i1','2001:db8:1:1200::1','2001:db8:1:1200::1','echo'),
      icmp('w3',0,1,2,'0/i1','2001:db8:1:1200::1','2001:db8:1:1200::1','echo'),
      icmp('w2',0,1,10,'0/i2','2001:db8:1:1200::2','2001:db8:1:1200::2','echo'),
      app('a1',3,'1'),app('a2',7,'2'),
      dele('w1',1,15),dele('w3',1,15)]
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':[{'id':'h','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':2}],
 'services':[{'id':'t','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[10,20],'captures':[cap(rows)],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
out=audit(parse_json(json.dumps(job).encode()))
print('rejected',out['rejected'])
for s in out['snapshots']:
 L=s['leases'][0]
 print(s['at'],L['state'],L['internal'],L['external'],L['unresolved'],s['unbound_applications'],L['services'][0])
EOF
